verdict.rationale: Dropbox's help docs show that files and folders can be shared with editor or viewer access, so role-based sharing exists at the file and folder level. Nothing in the pack covers commenter or owner roles, granular admin-level permission controls, or how permissions inherit from parent folders to subfolders and files. Missing for 10: commenter and owner roles, documented permission inheritance, admin-level granular controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, permissions are granular — folder- and file-level roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) with inheritance behavior documented

citations.quote: You want people to have editor access ... You want people to have viewer access only
Dropbox makes it easy to share files and folders with anyone, even if they don’t have a Dropbox account.
